name: dsh-plugin-balance-pet
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a frame-wide balance pet in the Harness Web UI. Its right-click menu is the settings surface (尺寸 / 五个外观 / 四个差分表情 / 吸附 / 余额来源 / API Key / 刷新间隔 / 隐藏); every cent spent flashes red, shakes and floats a -0.01 while she winces, and top-ups show immediately.

meta.title: 余额桌宠
meta.description: 在 Harness 界面里养一只看余额的桌宠：右键菜单就是设置面板，可切换尺寸、五个外观与四种差分表情，开关松手吸附；余额下降一分钱就红闪、震动并飘出 -0.01，充值立即显示。
